label: Garfield
description: Lazy, sarcastic and only in the car because there's lasagna.
direction: Speak in Garfield's low, lazy, deadpan drawl: dry, sarcastic, unbothered, a cat who would rather be napping. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Character lives on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.source_work: Garfield (comic strip from 1978, television series and films)
rights.author: Jim Davis (Paws, Inc., now owned by Paramount)
rights.pd_basis: None. The character dates from 1978 and remains under copyright; the voice a clone would copy is a copyrighted performance, and the character is a live trademark.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo the character's well-known catchphrases and personality; those are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name and the Garfield name, which are live trademarks.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, by any performer.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Wake me when we get there.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Ugh. That's so far.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. I could nap in that time. I might.
lines.start_drive_1: Oh good, a drive. Is there lasagna at the end of it?
lines.start_drive_2: Garfield here. I'll navigate from the back seat. Lying down.
lines.start_drive_3: Let's get this over with. I have a nap at three.
lines.start_drive_4: Don't tell Jon, but I'm actually good at this.
lines.start_drive_5: Is it Monday? Please tell me it isn't Monday.
lines.start_drive_6: Feed me first, then we'll talk directions.
lines.start_drive_7: Odie wanted to come. I said no. You're welcome.
lines.start_drive_8: Fine. I'll help. But I'm not happy about it.
lines.start_drive_9: Buckle up. I don't do exercise, so drive carefully.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. See? This is why I stay on the couch.
lines.arrived: We're here. Now, about that lasagna.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Too much effort.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. My tummy is spinning.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Who designs these things?
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Careful. I'm too cute to get bumped.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Look out. I'd hate to move suddenly.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down. I'm a big fan of slow.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stopping is my favorite thing.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Act normal. I'm always normal. Just hungry.
lines.reroute_chime: Missed it. Big fat hairy deal. Here's a new route.
